prompt:
A friend offers an elaborate favor when I only need a small amount of help. How can I accept kindly while keeping the arrangement manageable? Use approximately 200 words for the response.

Write the requested response as one self-contained paragraph of plain text. Do not use a title, headings, bullet points, numbered lists, Markdown formatting, code fences, or line breaks. Include only the requested content, without any introductory or closing commentary from the assistant. Keep the approximate word target given in the task. If the task calls for an email, dialogue, steps, or calculations, express that content within the same paragraph.
base_prompt: A friend offers an elaborate favor when I only need a small amount of help. How can I accept kindly while keeping the arrangement manageable? Use approximately 200 words for the response.
text: Thank you so much for offering to help—I really appreciate how thoughtful and generous you’re being. I only need a small amount of assistance, though, and I’d feel more comfortable keeping it simple and manageable for both of us. Would you be willing to help me with just [specific task], perhaps for [specific amount of time] or in whatever limited way works best for you? That would make a meaningful difference and would be more than enough. I don’t want you to feel responsible for solving the whole situation, and I certainly don’t want your kindness to become a major commitment. If the larger arrangement is something you genuinely want to do and it would be easy for you, I’m grateful, but please know that there’s no pressure at all. I’d also be happy to agree on the details ahead of time so we both have clear expectations, including when the help would happen and what I would handle myself. Your willingness to offer means a lot to me, whether you can provide the small favor I need or simply encourage me. I hope it’s okay that I’m being specific; I’m trying to accept your kindness in a way that respects your time and keeps things comfortable for both of us.
